governedSurface.adoption: Founder tap required; nothing in this module adopts, signs, or serves. Signing is a founder act with the offline key (host-side); load verification here refuses unsigned, tampered, or mis-pinned artifacts.
governedSurface.brains: Claude, Codex and Grok receive the brainExport only: recipe ids, hashes, license, Judge scores. Tensor bytes are structurally unreachable from the export (whitelist construction).
governedSurface.evidence: Shortlist entries require a re-openable source citation. Vendor claims are marked leads and refused at screening. Dark-web intake runs under the standing doctrine via the host's governed lane; queries are normalized host-side (no hardware or fleet identifiers).
governedSurface.execution: Synthesis and judging run in sealed ephemeral SPACE cells (host duty); this module is the deterministic core those cells call. Intermediates are RAM-only host-side; the twin runner wipes its scratch on every run.

installedFiles.lib/weightsynth-core.mjs: Canonical hashing, seeded PRNG (the engine's only randomness), FP32 merge math (linear/slerp/ties/dare), recipe validation + execution.
installedFiles.lib/weightsynth-judge.mjs: Pareto frontier, the balance rule with flagship quality floor, the Judge (held-out truth over suite score), deterministic seeded evolutionary search over linear recipes.
installedFiles.lib/weightsynth-registry.mjs: Parent registry (hash-only, license ladder, dirty-parent refusal), pin records + ed25519 load verification, the brains' metadata-only export, evidence intake (shortlist + hardware-profile screening).
installedFiles.lib/weightsynth-twin.mjs: The headless digital twin: canonical text specs (HEADLESS=always enforced), the folder work-list runner (order, receipts, amnesic scratch teardown, path-escape refusal).
installedFiles.twins/m3-8gb.twin.txt: Twin text spec for the 8 GB M3 profile (CAP_GB=5.5 weight budget).
installedFiles.twins/m5pro-24gb.twin.txt: Twin text spec for the 24 GB M5 Pro profile (CAP_GB=19 weight budget).

name: Weight Synthesis Engine — deterministic weight synthesis, judging, and sealing (native build)
role: Given a task lane, the engine finds the best weights for the founder's actual hardware and produces them deterministically: evidence intake whittles candidates to a sourced shortlist (community-measured and reported results; vendor claims are leads, never evidence; dark-web lane under the standing dark-web doctrine, queries normalized); recipes (parents by sha256, algorithm, coefficients, seed, suite, balance rule, environment) are content-addressed data; merge math (linear / slerp / TIES / DARE) runs FP32 in canonical order, CPU path only; the Judge scores suite quality against measured tok/s under the recipe's balance rule with a flagship quality floor; adoption requires proof by reproduction (the headless digital twin — a text spec that becomes an image on command and works a folder's work list down in order — re-runs the recipe to the identical sha256) and a founder tap; pins carry full parentage, inherit the strictest parent license, and load only under a detached ed25519 signature from the offline founder key.

Host wiring owed at drop-in: GGUF/safetensors adapters at the tensor boundary, evaluator/measurer transports (llama.cpp/Ollama + twin cells), the founder-tap adoption hook.
